dates: Written from memory of the five central banks' published decision calendars, because the build sandbox cannot reach their sites (none of these banks is in council/events.mjs, which covers US releases, the ECB and the BoJ only; its zonedToUtc is used for the local-to-UTC conversion). Not checked against the official pages. Where to check: Bank of England MPC dates and Monetary Policy Summaries (bankofengland.co.uk/monetary-policy/upcoming-mpc-dates and /monetary-policy-summary-and-minutes); Bank of Canada interest-rate announcement schedule and press releases (bankofcanada.ca/core-functions/monetary-policy/key-interest-rate/ and /press/press-releases/); Swiss National Bank monetary policy assessments (snb.ch/en/the-snb/mandates-goals/monetary-policy/decisions); Reserve Bank of Australia board meeting dates and monetary policy decisions (rba.gov.au/monetary-policy/int-rate-decisions/ and /schedules-events/); Reserve Bank of New Zealand OCR decision history (rbnz.govt.nz/monetary-policy/official-cash-rate-decisions).
scope: The frozen ecb-boj-days rule on five other central banks' scheduled decisions; a stand-alone event rule on forex, not a test of the gold book (owner decision item 44 untouched).
rule: direction of the first 60 minutes after the decision (close of the M5 candle ending at D + 60 min against the one ending at D); entry at D + 60 min in that direction, stop 1 x the 14-hour ATR known at D, no target, out at 21:00 UTC (BoE, BoC, SNB) / 15:00 UTC (RBA, RBNZ). D: 12:00 London, 09:45 or 10:00 Toronto (larger-range candle), 09:30 Zurich, 14:30 Sydney, 14:00 Wellington (before 2019 the larger-range candle of 09:00 and 14:00; 09:00 = no trade)
costs: per round trip 0.3 pip spread + 0.3 pip slippage + 45 USD per million notional commission (0.0045 % of the price)
